# Morph › Shape

**What belongs here.** One vector shape interpolates into another.

**Examples.** circle → square, icon → icon

**Family test.** Is something visibly one thing at the start and another thing at the end?

Each transition here has its own folder named by its id (lowercase, hyphens). See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../../CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Transitions

| Transition | Summary |
|---|---|
| [Frame Morph](frame-morph/) | The whole frame rounds and shrinks into a circle, the picture inside becomes the new scene, and the circle grows back into the full frame. |
